events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts shrugged on a TD celebration and did his best to be like Mike.
headlines.shortLinkText: Defending champion Eagles edge Cowboys 24-20 in wild, lightning-delayed NFL season opener

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Justin Herbert finished off the Los Angeles Chargers' season-opening victory in style, sliding for a first down that effectively ended the game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Herbert outduels Mahomes to help the Chargers beat the Chiefs 27-21 in Brazil

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Another visit to Mercedes-Benz Stadium produced more lasting memories for Emeka Egbuka.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buccaneers ride 2 TD catches by rookie Egbuka to dramatic 23-20 win over Penix, Falcons

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — DJ Turner and the Bengals defense heard the narrative throughout the offseason that they were mainly the reason why Cincinnati missed the playoffs last season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals defense leads the way to 17-16 win over the Browns in opener

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Indianapolis Colts quarterback Daniel Jones delivered the perfect start.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daniel Jones shines as Colts snap 11-game opening-day winless streak, beating Dolphins 33-8

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — With his team leading by 10 points and facing a long third down late in the fourth, Las Vegas Raiders quarterback Geno Smith was calm.
headlines.shortLinkText: Geno Smith passes for 362 yards and a TD in Raiders debut as Vegas thwarts Patriots 20-13

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Kyler Murray felt ill when he woke up Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray throws 2 TD passes to help the Cardinals hold on 20-13 in Saints coach Moore's debut

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Aaron Rodgers turned back the clock with a vintage performance in his Steelers debut that featured big throws, no turnovers and a late victory over...
headlines.shortLinkText: Aaron Rodgers throws 4 TD passes in his Steelers debut, leads 34-32 comeback win over Jets

events.name: New York Giants at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — When Washington lost in the NFC title game in January, the Commanders were so overmatched against Philadelphia's tush push that officials threatened to...
headlines.shortLinkText: Samuel scores in Washington debut, and the Commanders stifle the Giants in a 21-6 win

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — New Jaguars coach Liam Coen tried to stay out of the limelight in the postgame locker room. Team owner Shad Khan wouldn't let him.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lawrence and Etienne deliver as Jaguars open new regime with a 26-10 victory over the Panthers

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Denver's ferocious defense has no bigger fan than Bo Nix.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos spoil Cam Ward's debut with a 20-12 win over the Titans

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — When Brock Purdy commanded the huddle ahead of the San Francisco 49ers’ final drive, he provided a clear message to third-string tight end Jake Tonges and the rest of the offense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Third-stringer Jake Tonges' late TD catch gives the 49ers a 17-13 win over the Seahawks

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Micah Parsons' arrival in Green Bay helped the Packers put their recent NFC North struggles behind them.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love starts fast and Parsons gets a sack in his Green Bay debut as Packers defeat Lions 27-13

events.name: Houston Texans at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Davante Adams took a nasty upper-body hit from Houston linebacker Henry To'oTo'o while making his first reception for the Los Angeles Rams. Later in the first quarter, To'oTo'o knocked Puka Nacua's helmet sideways with a penalized head hit, putting...
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford tops 60,000 yards passing, defense stands strong as Rams hold off Texans 14-9

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Josh Allen had a message to the few thousands fans — and perhaps the entire NFL, for that matter — who left the stadium early to beat the traffic on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen rallies Bills for 16 points in last 4 minutes to stun Ravens 41-40 in prime-time thriller

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — J.J. McCarthy’s long-awaited debut for the Minnesota Vikings was looking more like a nightmare.
headlines.shortLinkText: J.J. McCarthy rallies the Vikings in the fourth quarter of his debut for a 27-24 win over the Bears

events.name: Washington Commanders at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Jordan Love and the Green Bay Packers have delivered a strong opening statement to the rest of the NFL.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love and Tucker Kraft lead the way in Packers' 27-18 victory over Commanders

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Jake Browning and the Cincinnati Bengals turned a nightmarish first half — including an injury to Joe Burrow — into a dream finish.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Browning relieves the injured Joe Burrow and scores late TD as Bengals beat Jaguars 31-27

events.name: New York Giants at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott wasn't thinking late in a wild duel with Russell Wilson about his long personal winning streak against the New York Giants, and probably not about the prospect of Brian Schottenheimer's first victory as a head coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aubrey ends wild Prescott-Wilson duel with FG as time expires in OT as Cowboys top Giants 40-37

events.name: Chicago Bears at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions showed they can pile up points just fine without Ben Johnson calling plays.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff throws 5 TDs, 3 to St. Brown, and Lions bounce back with 52-21 win over Ben Johnson-led Bears

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — The Los Angeles Rams know how efficient they can be on offense. They clicked into high gear Sunday when they had to, scoring 20 straight points to spoil rookie Cam Ward's NFL home opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford throws 2 TDs as Rams spoil home opener for Titans and Cam Ward

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Antonio Gibson burst through the Miami Dolphins' coverage unit on a kick return and dived into the end zone while New England coach Mike Vrabel excitedly chased him almost the entire way down the Patriots' sideline.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maye accounts for 3 TDs and Patriots top Dolphins 33-27 for Vrabel's 1st win as New England coach

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Mac Jones' San Francisco teammates kept mentioning what a luxury it is for the 49ers to have a backup quarterback who exudes the “confidence” and “swagger” of a starter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mac Jones shines in relief of Brock Purdy as the 49ers top the Saints 26-21

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Josh Allen's nose might have taken the biggest hit by the Buffalo Bills against the New York Jets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen bounces back from bloody nose, leads Bills to easy 30-10 victory over Jets

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — George Holani saw the ball bouncing toward the Pittsburgh end zone, wondered why Steelers kick returner Kaleb Johnson turned his back on a live football, and kept right on running.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks' George Holani turns the Steelers' blunder on a kickoff into a TD as Seattle wins 31-17

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — The Baltimore Ravens finished this game better than they started it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson throws 4 TD passes, and the Ravens close strong in a 41-17 victory over the Browns

events.name: Denver Broncos at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Indianapolis Colts kicker Spencer Shrader missed one opportunity to beat the Denver Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spencer Shrader converts from 45 yards after penalty on 60-yard miss and Colts beat Broncos 29-28

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Calais Campbell and his 39-year-old body came up with a game-ending sack to help the Arizona Cardinals secure a 27-22 win on Sunday over the Carolina Panthers, turning back a frantic...
headlines.shortLinkText: Calais Campbell's sack with 26 seconds left secures Cardinals' 27-22 win after Carolina comeback try

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The goal for the Philadelphia Eagles is to be playing their best at the end of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles' defense shines in Super Bowl rematch as Philly beats the Chiefs 20-17 at Arrowhead Stadium

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — Bijan Robinson got back to work on the ground, and the Atlanta Falcons were back in business.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons trample J.J. McCarthy and the Vikings 22-6 behind Bijan Robinson's running, dominant defense

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — Two years ago, the Tampa Bay Buccaneers lost to the Houston Texans on a touchdown in the final seconds.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baker Mayfield and Rachaad White rally Bucs to 20-19 win over Texans

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Las Vegas Raiders
Miami Dolphins at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Buffalo Bills linebacker Terrel Bernard diagnosed the play as soon as Tua Tagovailoa dropped back in the pocket.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen's 3 TD passes and Terrel Bernard's pick secure Bills' 31-21 win over spiraling Dolphins

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Andre Szmyt has gone from being nearly run of town to being one of the most popular Browns players in Cleveland.
headlines.shortLinkText: Andre Szmyt's 55-yard field goal as time expires rallies Browns to 13-10 victory over Packers

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — The Indianapolis Colts had a feeling in pregame warmups that their best start since 2009 was theirs for the taking.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonathan Taylor's 3 TDs keeps Colts undefeated with 41-20 thumping of winless Titans

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — Carson Wentz had some strong emotions to channel and a little rust to shake off, taking over at quarterback in Minnesota for the team he grew up rooting for.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings sail past bumbling Bengals 48-10 in Wentz's debut behind pair of TDs on D by Isaiah Rodgers

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Aaron Rodgers doesn't think the Steelers did nearly enough with the chances they had with the ball against the Patriots.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aaron Rodgers throws 2 TD passes and Steelers force 5 turnovers to beat Patriots 21-14

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Jordan Davis clutched the ball in his outstretched right hand as he reached the end zone and had no choice but to freeze and meet the mob of Eagles sprinting his way.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Davis seals Eagles' 33-26 thrilling win over Rams with Philly's 2nd blocked FG of 4th quarter

events.name: New York Jets at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield led the Buccaneers to another thrilling finish, ensuring Tampa Bay's best start in 20 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baker Mayfield leads undefeated Buccaneers to another thrilling victory, 29-27 over winless Jets

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — With so many changes to the starting offense — either because of injuries, such as to Jayden Daniels and Austin Ekeler, or coaching decisions seeking improvement after a bad loss — the <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Marcus Mariota and a reconfigured Commanders offense run past the Raiders 41-24

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Bryce Young ran for a touchdown, Chau Smith-Wade returned an interception 11 yards for a score and rookie Ryan Fitzgerald made three field goals and the Carolina Panthers routed the Atlanta Falcons 30-0 on Sunday for their first win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers dominate Falcons 30-0 for first win of the season

events.name: Houston Texans at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Brian Thomas Jr. was so frustrated by his latest drop — and the ensuing boos — that he slammed his helmet into the ground near the bench.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brian Thomas Jr. comes up big late as the Jaguars send the Texans to 0-3 with a 17-10 victory

events.name: Denver Broncos at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Keenan Allen wasn't catching Justin Herbert's throws early. The veteran wide receiver made a play when it mattered most.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Herbert rallies Chargers for 23-20 win over Broncos and 3-0 start

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Tory Horton felt like a kid when he backpedaled and fielded a New Orleans punt deep in Seattle territory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tory Horton returns punt 95 yards for a score and has TD catch in Seahawks' 44-13 rout of Saints

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Ben Johnson had just presented game balls to Caleb Williams and Tremaine Edmunds in a raucous locker room. There was one more to give.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams ties career high with 4 TD passes, Ben Johnson gets 1st win as Bears beat Cowboys

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — The San Francisco 49ers had lost another star to an injury, given up a fourth-quarter lead on a safety and were relying on a backup quarterback and a brand new kicker to maintain their perfect start to the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pineiro's last-second field goal lifts 49ers to thrilling 16-15 win over Cardinals

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Mistakes and penalties threatened to derail the Kansas City Chiefs again early in a season that had not been going their way. Patrick Mahomes made a couple himself.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs beat the Giants 22-9 for their first win this season

events.name: Detroit Lions at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — Punishing all night — and tricky when they had to be — the Detroit Lions battered the Baltimore Ravens with a performance that epitomized everything they've become under coach Dan Campbell.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions run over the Ravens, sack Lamar Jackson 7 times in a 38-30 win over Baltimore

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — The Seattle Seahawks could have been shell-shocked, giving up a 14-point lead during the latter half of the fourth quarter and turning their comfortable advantage into a tie game with 33 seconds left.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jason Myers boots 52-yard FG on final play, lifting Seahawks to 23-20 win over Cardinals

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Even though he's relatively new to the Pittsburgh Steelers, Aaron Rodgers fully understands the Rooney family's connections to the Emerald Isle.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers hold on for 24-21 win over Vikings in NFL's first regular-season game in Ireland

events.name: Washington Commanders at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Falcons coach Raheem Morris didn't hesitate when he was asked when he saw something that confirmed his belief in Michael Penix Jr. after last week's disastrous loss to Carolina.
headlines.shortLinkText: Penix and Robinson have career-best days to lead Falcons to 34-27 win over short-handed Commanders

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — With the outcome still in doubt midway through the fourth quarter, and Buffalo facing third down at midfield, Bills defensive tackle Jordan Phillips could sense it was Josh Allen's time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen combines for 3 TDs and Bills improve to 4-0 with 31-19 victory over winless Saints

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Jared Goff's connection with Amon-Ra St. Brown is so good, it helped the Detroit Lions overcome a relatively lackluster game on offense to rout the <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff throws 2 TD passes to St. Brown, Lions beat Browns 34-10 for 3rd straight victory

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Almost nothing went right for the New England Patriots during their loss to Pittsburgh last week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marcus Jones' 87-yard punt return TD sparks Patriots offense in 42-13 romp over Panthers

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Brian Daboll found a grinning Jaxson Dart on the field after the New York Giants' first victory of the season, hugged the rookie quarterback around his neck and then giving him a big slap on the chest.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dart's impressive debut leads Giants to 1st win over Chargers, but await word on Nabers' injury

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — The Philadelphia Eagles don't need a tush push when the fake is even more effective.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fake tush push and special teams TD help Eagles beat Bucs 31-25 to stay undefeated

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — Houston's defense got its first shutout in almost 15 years and the offense did the rest Sunday against the Tennessee Titans to give the Texans their first win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans dominate Titans 26-0 for first win of the season

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Tutu Atwell hasn't received many opportunities to make big plays in his five seasons with the Los Angeles Rams. He knew he finally had a chance Sunday when he looked over his shoulder to see Matthew Stafford's perfect spiral sailing toward him, and...
headlines.shortLinkText: Tutu Atwell makes a late 88-yard TD catch, and Rams rally past Colts 27-20 after Mitchell's fumble

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — With the way the defense and special teams are playing for Jacksonville in the opening month of the season, the Jaguars are able to keep pulling out wins even if Trevor Lawrence and the offense aren't yet operating at peak efficiency.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars beat 49ers 26-21 with Washington's punt return TD, 4 takeaways

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The Kansas City Chiefs are getting healthier, deeper and more dynamic as the season presses on.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes shines for Chiefs, Jackson adds to Ravens' injury woes as Kansas City rolls to 37-20 victory

events.name: Chicago Bears at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — In the end, the Bears' win over the Raiders came down to Josh Blackwell getting a hand on a field-goal attempt.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Blackwell blocks field goal to preserve Bears' rally for 25-24 win over Raiders

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Micah Parsons and Dak Prescott both said winning was the only thing that mattered in the Green Bay pass rusher's hyped return to Dallas to face...
headlines.shortLinkText: Micah Parsons' hyped return to Dallas ends with Cowboys and Packers in 40-40 tie
